name: Electrical Industries Company
summary: Electrical Industries Company engages in the manufacture, assembly, supply, repair, and maintenance of transformers, compact substations and low voltage distribution panels, electrical distribution boards, cable trays, switch gears, and other electrical equipment. The company provides distribution and medium power transformers, package substations, and low voltage panels; electrical distribution equipment; and project engineering and turnkey solutions, as well as technical services. It serves commercial, residential, and industrial sectors in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, rest of Gulf countries, Europe, and Asia.
